categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the manufacturing of enameled wires (漆包線), copper materials processing including rolling, drawing, and extrusion, electronic components manufacturing, and international trade. Its main product is enameled wire used in motors, transformers, coils, and various electronic applications. The company also produces twisted wires and other related wire products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced wire drawing, coating, and baking processes to produce high-quality enameled wires. It focuses on developing high-temperature resistant, high-conductivity, low-loss, and special alloy composite wires. The production process includes integrated steps from bare copper wire drawing to coating and baking, with ongoing R&D in ultra-fine wires, self-fusing wires, and environmentally friendly coatings.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in the home appliance, electronic information, motor, transformer, and 3C (computer, communication, consumer electronics) industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, with a significant export focus on China and Southeast Asia. Major end markets are electronics, automotive, telecommunications, and electrical equipment sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing plants in Tainan and Yongkang, and sales offices in Taipei. It has established overseas production and sales subsidiaries in China (Suzhou, Dongguan) and Vietnam to serve the Asian market. Export sales are primarily concentrated in China, followed by Vietnam and other countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream segment of the wire and cable supply chain, processing raw copper materials into finished enameled wires and related products. It sources raw copper wire from upstream suppliers and sells finished wires to downstream manufacturers in electronics, motor, and electrical industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing high-value-added special enameled wires such as high-temperature resistant, self-fusing, and environmentally friendly wires. The company emphasizes low-carbon and sustainable production, automation, and smart manufacturing systems. R&D focuses on new materials, ultra-fine wires, IoT applications, EV motor wires, and expanding product applications in emerging markets.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of enameled wires and related wire products. The company also earns income from its subsidiaries and investments. Sales are conducted via direct sales channels to industrial customers domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading professional manufacturer of enameled wires in Taiwan with a strong market position supported by technology transfer and cooperation with Japanese firms. It competes with domestic and regional wire manufacturers, particularly those in China and South Korea. Its competitive advantages include advanced production technology, quality control, and a diversified product portfolio.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$3.4 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 20% increase from the prior year. Net profit improved significantly to NT$78.8 million from a prior loss. Total assets grew by 15% to about NT$3.7 billion, and equity increased by 13%. The company shows a positive growth trajectory with improving profitability and expanding market presence.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-performance enameled wires with unique features such as ultra-fine diameters, high temperature resistance, and environmentally friendly coatings. It leverages proprietary technology and strict quality control to reduce production losses and costs. The company also focuses on sustainable manufacturing and intellectual property to maintain a differentiated market position and meet evolving customer demands.
